name: Karen K. Davis
office: City of Glendora, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Karen K. Davis is a member of the Glendora City Council, first elected in 2005, and has been selected to serve as mayor four times. She is the pastor of First Christian Church of Glendora.

sentences.text: Karen K. Davis is a member of the Glendora City Council, first elected in 2005, and has been selected to serve as mayor four times.
She is the pastor of First Christian Church of Glendora.

items.text: In a 2026 election questionnaire, she said the city should meet housing mandates by targeting higher-density development in appropriate areas. She also supports exploring a diversity of housing types. She supports finding new revenue through economic development and grants, and wants to seek citizen input on other options. Her campaign says she supports investments in public safety and responsible spending. She also advocates for local businesses and preserving the character of Glendora.
